## **Hello everybody and welcome!**

I'm an assistant professor in the [Department of Statistics, Applied Economics and Management Organization](https://www.uco.es/organiza/departamentos/estadistica/) at the [University of Córdoba](https://www.uco.es/). I received my PhD in Social Science from the same University in 2019.

<!--Previously, I was Associate Professor of Economics at [Hood College](https://www.hood.edu/academics/departments/george-b-delaplaine-jr-school-business), and I have taught 17 different economics courses over the last 10 years. I am a firm believer of providing public goods & promoting open source materials, so you can find all course materials on my custom [course websites](teaching.qmd).-->
 
My personal research explores the analysis of [demographic phenomena](https://www.demogr.mpg.de/en/about_us_6113/what_is_demography_6674/) and the application of computational methods for modelling them. Quantitative finance, economics and the field of  [econophysics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Econophysics) are other lines in my research profile.

I am a passionate user of [*R*](https://www.r-project.org/) and [*Python*](https://www.python.org/) for statistics and economics, data analysis and visualization and [Quarto](https://quarto.org/), [Git](https://git-scm.com/) and [Github](https://github.com/), among other software, for writing reproducible research, using version control, and managing my workflow. I blog [here](/blog) about using these tools in my research, teaching and learning and how to use new tools and software for open science.
